name: codex-extensible-workflows
description: Deterministic, resumable multi-agent workflows for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Build and run guided multi-agent workflows
interface.longDescription: Adds a conversational setup wizard and local workflow tools that assign optional models per subagent, fan Codex tasks out in parallel, wait efficiently, retry with durable lineage, optionally report progress, and recover without repeating completed work.
defaultPrompt: Run parallel correctness, security, and test reviews
Create a Codex workflow for this task
Start the workflow wizard for this project
Configure a workflow with a different model for each subagent
Run this workflow with progress updates
